description: Excalidraw multi-user real-time collaborative whiteboard MVP

userStories.title: Monorepo scaffold (pnpm workspace + client + server)
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a monorepo structure with client and server packages so that both can be developed together with shared tooling.
acceptanceCriteria: Root package.json with pnpm workspace config (pnpm-workspace.yaml)
packages/client: React 19 + Vite 6 + TypeScript, can run `pnpm dev` and see blank page at localhost:5173
packages/server: Hono + @hono/node-server + TypeScript, can run `pnpm dev` and get HTTP response at localhost:3001/api/health
Root dev script runs both client and server in parallel (`pnpm dev`)
tsconfig.base.json shared at root, both packages extend it
Git repo initialized with initial commit on main branch
Typecheck passes for both packages (`npx tsc --noEmit`)
userStories.notes: Scaffold pre-built, fixed typecheck errors: PointerUpdate type (use local PointerData), EXCALIDRAW_ASSET_PATH (declare global), upgradeWebSocket (not in @hono/node-server 1.19, use createAdaptorServer + ws upgrade handler)

userStories.title: Backend Hono + WebSocket echo server
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a WebSocket endpoint on the backend so that clients can connect and exchange messages in real-time.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /ws endpoint accepts WebSocket upgrade using @hono/node-server upgradeWebSocket
WebSocket server created with ws.WebSocketServer({ noServer: true })
Server echoes any received message back to the sender (basic echo)
Server logs connection and disconnection events to console
HTTP and WebSocket share the same port (3001)
Server starts with `pnpm --filter @exceldraw-collab/server dev` using tsx watch
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: WebSocket upgrade handled via createAdaptorServer + server.on('upgrade') + ws.WebSocketServer({ noServer: true }). Echo for non-JSON raw data; structured messages handled by protocol. Note: upgradeWebSocket not available in @hono/node-server for Node.js.

userStories.title: Database schema and board CRUD API
userStories.description: As a developer, I need SQLite tables and REST endpoints for board management so that boards can be created, listed, and retrieved.
acceptanceCriteria: better-sqlite3 initialized with WAL mode and foreign keys enabled
boards table: id (TEXT PK, random hex), name (TEXT), created_at (INTEGER), updated_at (INTEGER)
board_elements table: board_id (TEXT PK FK), elements_json (TEXT), updated_at (INTEGER)
Schema created via initSchema() on first DB connection
DB file stored at packages/server/data/collab.db (auto-created directory)
POST /api/boards - creates board, returns { id, name, created_at, updated_at }, status 201
GET /api/boards - returns array of all boards ordered by updated_at DESC
GET /api/boards/:id - returns single board or 404
PUT /api/boards/:id/elements - upserts elements_json for a board
GET /api/boards/:id/elements - returns parsed elements array
All endpoints return proper JSON and status codes
CORS enabled for /api/* routes
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Pre-built, verified all endpoints. better-sqlite3 uses .bind().get() pattern. RETURNING clause works with .get(). Added *.db-shm/*.db-wal to .gitignore.

userStories.title: WebSocket room management and message broadcast
userStories.description: As a developer, I need server-side room management so that WebSocket messages are broadcast only to clients in the same board room.
acceptanceCriteria: Room manager module (ws/room.ts) with: joinRoom, leaveRoom, getRoomClients, broadcastToRoom, getRoomSize
Rooms stored as Map<string, Map<string, ClientInfo>> in memory
ClientInfo includes: socketId, username, ws reference
JOIN message handler: stores roomId/username on socket context, returns INIT with existing users, broadcasts USER_JOINED to others
ELEMENTS_UPDATE message handler: broadcasts to all room clients except sender
POINTER_UPDATE message handler: broadcasts to all room clients except sender
onClose handler: removes client from room, broadcasts USER_LEFT to remaining clients
Message protocol matches types defined in ARCHITECTURE.md
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Pre-built, multi-client room test passed: JOIN→INIT/USER_JOINED, ELEMENTS_UPDATE broadcast, POINTER_UPDATE broadcast, disconnect→USER_LEFT all verified.

userStories.title: Frontend Excalidraw SDK integration (blank board renders)
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see a blank Excalidraw canvas when I open the app so that I can start drawing.
acceptanceCriteria: @excalidraw/excalidraw@^0.18.1 installed and imported
Whiteboard component renders Excalidraw with 100% height/width container
Excalidraw CSS imported (@excalidraw/excalidraw/index.css)
window.EXCALIDRAW_ASSET_PATH set to '/' for self-hosted fonts
Fonts copied from node_modules/@excalidraw/excalidraw/dist/prod/fonts to packages/client/public/fonts/ (via install:fonts script or postinstall)
TailwindCSS 4 configured with @tailwindcss/vite plugin, base styles applied
App renders without console errors at localhost:5173
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Copied Excalidraw fonts to public/fonts/, added install:fonts + postinstall scripts. Vite build succeeds (2350 modules). Typecheck passes.

userStories.title: Frontend WebSocket client and element sync
userStories.description: As a user, I want my drawing changes to be sent to the server and other users' changes to appear on my canvas in real-time.
acceptanceCriteria: CollabSocket class in src/collab/socket.ts with: connect, disconnect, sendElementsUpdate, sendPointerUpdate
WebSocket URL constructed from window.location (ws:// or wss://) with /ws path
On connect: sends JOIN message with roomId and username
Excalidraw onChange callback sends ELEMENTS_UPDATE via CollabSocket
INIT message handler loads initial elements via excalidrawAPI.updateScene()
ELEMENTS_UPDATE message handler merges incoming elements using reconcileElements pattern (union by element ID, latest version wins)
Auto-reconnect on disconnect with 3-second delay
Whiteboard component accepts roomId prop and initializes CollabSocket on mount
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: CollabSocket refactored: callback-based connect(onMessage), reconcileElements with AppState param. Whiteboard wired onChange→sendElementsUpdate, onPointerUpdate→sendPointerUpdate, ELEMENTS_UPDATE→mergeElements+updateScene. Auto-reconnect on disconnect. Types: OrderedExcalidrawElement not re-exported, used @ts-expect-error import.

userStories.title: Remote cursor display for other users
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see other users' cursor positions on the canvas so I know where they are looking/drawing.
acceptanceCriteria: Excalidraw onPointerUpdate callback sends POINTER_UPDATE via CollabSocket with pointer data
POINTER_UPDATE messages rendered using Excalidraw's built-in collaboration cursor support (collaborators prop or custom cursor overlay)
Each remote user gets a unique cursor color (derive from socketId hash)
Username displayed near each remote cursor
Cursors disappear when user leaves the room (USER_LEFT message)
Cursor updates are smooth (no visible lag from message batching)
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill: open two tabs, see cursor movement in both
userStories.notes: Uses Excalidraw built-in collaborators map via updateScene({ appState: { collaborators } }). Color derived from socketId hash (hsl). Pointer updates rendered in real-time. USER_LEFT removes cursor.

userStories.title: Board list page (create, view, join)
userStories.description: As a user, I want a landing page where I can see existing boards, create a new one, and join a board to start collaborating.
acceptanceCriteria: BoardList component at route '/' fetches GET /api/boards on mount
Displays board list with name and relative creation time (e.g. '2 hours ago')
'Create New Board' button at top, prompts for board name (inline input, not alert/prompt)
POST /api/boards called on create, new board appears in list immediately
Each board item is a clickable link/card that navigates to /board/:id
Empty state message when no boards exist: 'No boards yet. Create one to get started.'
Responsive layout using TailwindCSS (works on mobile and desktop)
Board route (/board/:id) renders Whiteboard component with the board ID
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill: create a board, see it in list, click to navigate

userStories.title: Element persistence (auto-save to SQLite)
userStories.description: As a user, I want my drawing to be saved automatically so that if I refresh the page, my work is not lost.
acceptanceCriteria: Debounced save: on ELEMENTS_UPDATE, after 2 seconds of no changes, call PUT /api/boards/:id/elements
On initial room join (INIT), load saved elements from GET /api/boards/:id/elements and pass to Excalidraw initialData
Manual save trigger: keyboard shortcut Ctrl+S explicitly saves current elements
Save indicator in UI (subtle text 'Saving...' / 'Saved') near top of whiteboard
No data loss on page refresh: elements loaded from server match what was last drawn
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill: draw something, refresh, drawing persists

userStories.title: End-to-end collaboration smoke test
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to verify that two users can draw on the same board simultaneously and see each other's changes in real-time.
acceptanceCriteria: Two browser tabs can connect to the same board room
Drawing in tab A appears in tab B within 1 second
Cursor movement in tab A appears as remote cursor in tab B
Elements persist after both tabs refresh
No console errors in either tab during normal usage
Server correctly handles disconnect/reconnect (user leaves tab, rejoins)
User count in room updates correctly (join increases, leave decreases)
